inputs.name: Semisimplified local-global compatibility at the coefficient prime
inputs.author: Thomas Barnet-Lamb, Toby Gee, David Geraghty and Richard Taylor
inputs.title: Local-global compatibility for l=p, II, Ann. Sci. ENS 47 (2014), 165--179
inputs.theorem_reference: Theorem A p.2; definition of Shin-regular p.5; Theorem1.1 and Corollary1.2 p.6 (author PDF)
inputs.accepted_statement: At every v|ell, a regular algebraic essentially (conjugate) self-dual cuspidal pair has semisimplified local compatibility; if the weight is Shin-regular, the full Frobenius-semisimplified Weil-Deligne parameter matches rec(pi_v|det|^((1-n)/2)).
